_comment: HARDENED POLICY — Production-ready S3 access control pattern
_design_principles: Specific principal: named role ARN only, no wildcards
Minimum required actions: GetObject only, no ListBucket or PutObject
Explicit deny block: prevents public access even if Block Public Access is misconfigured
VPC endpoint condition: restricts access to traffic originating from within the VPC

Statement._principal_note: Specific role ARN only. No wildcard. No account-root reference.
Statement._action_note: Minimum required permission. No s3:ListBucket, s3:PutObject, or s3:DeleteObject unless explicitly required.

Condition._condition_note: Requests must originate from within the specified VPC via a VPC endpoint. External access is denied even with valid credentials.

Statement._deny_note: Deny all requests not using TLS. This is a defense-in-depth measure against HTTP data interception.
